steps.content: At some point, the relentless dark tides finally recede.
A blinding red moon rises from the horizon. Even the darkness cannot contend against it, disappearing without a trace.
You open your eyes. Under the blood-red light, a vast, dilapidated, humid city instantly fills your view.
In this eerie red city, vague yet familiar figures weave through the crumbling, decaying buildings.
Driven by an inexplicable impulse, you advance mindlessly, coming to a broken pillar.
You lift the algae off it and wipe away the sticky silt. A name that stirs your heart appears on it.
